event_description: Fired server-side when a Yale SSO or dev-credentials user successfully completes authentication.
Fired when an applicant requests a magic-link sign-in email to access the apply portal.
Fired when an applicant saves their in-progress application draft.
Fired when an applicant successfully submits a recruitment application.
Fired when a recruitment coordinator accepts an applicant into a department.
Fired when a previously granted acceptance is revoked by a coordinator.
Fired when an applicant is scheduled for a department interview.
Fired when a recruitment coordinator bulk-releases cycle decisions to all applicants.
Fired when accepted members are promoted into active membership after completing onboarding contracts.
Fired when a signed-in member submits a new incident or concern report.
Fired when a member submits a training quiz attempt, capturing pass/fail and score.
Fired when a learner's SCORM course progress is committed, including completion status.
